props.title: Hyatt Regency Denver at Colorado Convention Center
props.lede: Hyatt Regency Denver is the big hotel connected to the Colorado Convention Center, with 1,100 guest rooms and the largest hotel ballroom in the state.

headingText.html: A lot of the conference receptions, awards dinners and company parties in Denver happen here, along with big weddings, and the rooftop terrace looks out over the skyline.

props.title: Event spaces at Hyatt Regency Denver

spaces.name: Denver City Terrace
spaces.facts: The Denver City Terrace is a rooftop with views of the skyline, about 3,500 sq ft, for up to 300 guests. The hotel holds wedding ceremonies up there.
spaces.why: The hotel holds ceremonies up on the rooftop terrace, and strings with the skyline behind you are hard to top.
spaces.alt: A long high-top table set for dinner on the Denver City Terrace, with the convention center behind.

spaces.name: Centennial Ballroom
spaces.facts: The Centennial Ballroom is about 30,000 sq ft with 30-foot ceilings, for banquets of up to about 1,900 guests and receptions of up to 3,000. It divides into smaller sections, and the Centennial Foyer outside it holds receptions of up to 1,500.
spaces.why: Little Moses Jones bring the energy for a crowd this size, and their own sound engineer, too.

spaces.name: Capitol Ballroom
spaces.facts: The Capitol Ballroom has 22-foot ceilings and hand-blown Italian glass light fixtures, for seated events of up to about 1,200.
spaces.why: A soul and R&B band under those Italian glass fixtures.

spaces.name: Silver Room
spaces.facts: The Silver Room is about 1,200 sq ft with floor-to-ceiling windows, for rehearsal dinners and small receptions.
spaces.why: A jazz duo for a rehearsal dinner in the Silver Room.
spaces.alt: The Silver Room set with cocktail tables and flowers, with floor-to-ceiling windows.

props.title: Planning music at Hyatt Regency Denver

rows.text: The sound can run from a small speaker on the terrace to a full stage system in the Centennial Ballroom, depending on the act.
It’s a big hotel with a lot going on, so we plan load-in with the events team and the convention services staff.
When a big convention is in town, the hotel and the streets around it are busy, so we build in extra time for the act to arrive and set up.
Hyatt Regency Denver has self-parking and valet for guests.

props.html: Questions about music at Hyatt Regency Denver

items.q: How much does live music add to a Hyatt Regency Denver wedding?
items.a: It depends on the act and how much of the day you’d like music for, from a violinist on the terrace to a band in the Capitol Ballroom. Learn more about live music costs in Denver on our pricing page, and send us the date when you have it.
